top_signals.title: Treasury Yields Extend Past Month’s Slide as Oil Prices Drop
top_signals.summary: Treasuries rose, building on their biggest monthly advance in more than two years, as tumbling oil prices eased concern about inflation pressure leading to additional Federal Reserve interest-rate hikes.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Central-bank repricing affecting yields, FX, liquidity and equities.

top_signals.title: Citi FX Traders Back Carry but Warn Against ‘Set and Forget’
top_signals.summary: Citigroup Inc.’s US currency desk expects the carry trade to keep offering opportunities for investors even though the strategy may struggle to replicate a period of standout returns.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: ETF Anthropic Exposure, Political Funds, BOJ Unwinds ETFs
top_signals.summary: "Bloomberg ETF IQ" focuses on the opportunities, risks and current trends tied to the trillions of dollars in the global exchange traded funds industry. Today's guests: Active Investment Company Alliance Founder & Executive Chair John Cole Scott, Tema ETFs Head of Investment Strategy Paisley Nardini, Subversive ETFs Portfolio Manager Dan Weiskopf, and National Banks of Canada Capital Markets Linda Ma.  (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: Central-bank repricing affecting yields, FX, liquidity and equities.

top_signals.title: Learjet May Have Broken Up Before Fatal Florida Crash, NTSB Says
top_signals.summary: US air safety investigators said there are early indications the Learjet 60 that crashed in Palm Beach, Florida, on Sunday had broken up before impacting the ground, killing all nine people on board and injuring at least one person on the ground. (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.

top_signals.title: Crypto's Washington playbook is working. Don't abandon it now.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Digital asset volatility and institutional crypto positioning changes.

top_signals.title: Strive inches closer to becoming second-largest public bitcoin holder after latest $10 million buy
top_signals.summary: Strive bought another 124 BTC, bringing it closer to becoming the second-largest public company holder of bitcoin after Strategy.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Digital asset volatility and institutional crypto positioning changes.

top_signals.title: Anthropic reports $17 billion in Q3 revenue, purchase commitments of $895.4 billion in revised S-1
top_signals.summary: Anthropic unveiled its S-1 prospectus last week, but the initial filing only included the company's financials through the first half of the year.

top_signals.title: Your Mobile Carrier Stores Your Call Logs for Years
top_signals.summary: Mobile carriers can retain years of call and text metadata, exposing sensitive details about customers' relationships, locations, and daily routines if breached. Cape examines the privacy risks of long-term telecom data retention and how its mobile service reduces exposure by automatically deleting call records. [...]
